mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.*, s.id as schedule_id, s.day_of_week, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.classroom_id, cr.name as classroom_name, u.id as teacher_id, u.username as teacher_name FROM courses c INNER JOIN selections sel ON c.id = sel.course_id LEFT JOIN schedules s ON c.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN classrooms cr ON s.classroom_id = cr.id LEFT JOIN course_teachers ct ON c.id = ct.course_id LEFT JOIN users u ON ct.teacher_id = u.id WHERE sel.user_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courses(course_name, description, credits, weekly_hours, weekly_sessions) VALUES(#{courseName}, #{description}, #{credits}, #{weeklyHours}, #{weeklySessions})
mapper.update: UPDATE courses SET course_name = #{courseName}, description = #{description}, credits = #{credits}, weekly_hours = #{weeklyHours}, weekly_sessions = #{weeklySessions} WHERE id = #{id}
